__metadata_header__: Title                : Enterprise-Grade Interactive Sales & Profitability Dashboard
Purpose/Description  : Fully operational layout incorporating multi-field filters, bubble
maps, margin scorecards, dual-channel timelines, product slices,
and customer leaderboards within an optimized 16-row layout matrix.

options.markdown:
# 🏢 Global Commerce Revenue & Margin Optimization Hub
*Interactive asset compiled dynamically using Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs).*

widgets.title: Sales Distribution & Volume Intensity by Region
Top 5 Enterprise Customers by Gross Sales
Total Revenue Trend: Online vs Offline Channels

datasets.name: Global_Sales_Semantic_Core
datasets.query: SELECT f.sale_id, c.customer_name, p.product_category, l.region, l.latitude, l.longitude, d.calendar_year, d.calendar_month, f.sales_channel, f.total_amount as gross_sales, (f.total_amount - (p.unit_cost * f.quantity)) as net_revenue, (((f.total_amount - (p.unit_cost * f.quantity)) / f.total_amount) * 100) as profit_margin_pct FROM ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.fact_sales f INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_customers c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_locations l ON f.location_id = l.location_id INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_dates d ON f.date_id = d.date_id

datasets.name: Top_Customers_Leaderboard
datasets.query: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(f.total_amount) as customer_gross_sales FROM ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.fact_sales f INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_customers c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY customer_gross_sales DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: Channel_Performance_Dataset
datasets.query: SELECT d.calendar_date, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_channel = 'ONLINE' THEN f.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as online_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_channel = 'OFFLINE' THEN f.total_amount ELSE 0 END) as offline_revenue FROM ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.fact_sales f INNER JOIN ${bundle.variables.target_catalog}.${bundle.variables.target_schema}.dim_dates d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.calendar_date ORDER BY d.calendar_date ASC
